purpose: Deterministic semantic 2D audio commands, events, voice inspection, and failure results without scanning the audio implementation.
read_policy: Use the command/result/event contracts first. Open only AudioSystem2D.hpp or AudioComponents2D.hpp when an exact enum, source field, or less-common voice operation is required.

contracts.summary: Start audio for an entity that owns a valid AudioSource2D. The returned AudioPlayResult2D contains a machine-distinguishable AudioCommandResult2D and generation-safe voice handle.
Advance semantic audio state explicitly by a validated delta and publish bounded semantic events; this is not an audio-output callback.
Read semantic Started/Stopped/Stolen/Looped/Finished/Detached evidence after commands/steps. ClearEvents() explicitly resets retained event evidence.
Inspect a live generation-safe voice without backend-handle exposure; stale/finished identities resolve to no snapshot.
Structured command failure contract including not-found/source-invalid/clip-not-ready/stale/invalid-state/voice-limit/capacity outcomes.
